body.name: Switching branch coverage \(K_{\mathrm{sw}}\) and protocol weight \(w\)
body.construction: For \(S\in\Pi\) and \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\in\Omega\), let \(\alpha\in K_{\mathrm{sw}}(S)\) exactly when there exist a catalogue-consistent label \(\ell\), a labelled single-district factor \(T\), and a finite transcript \(\tau\) satisfying all of the following conditions: \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\) returns a law handle and exact support table; that table assigns positive mass to \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\); \(T\) is extracted from \(\operatorname{Slice}(S,\ell)\) and passes measured-ancestry typing; and \(\tau\) verifies a successful \(\operatorname{IDENTIFY}^{+}\) ancestor--district recursion for the concrete assignment and equality type \(\omega\) of \(C_j\).  Define \(w(S)=\sum_{a\in S}c(a)\).  Thus membership in \(K_{\mathrm{sw}}(S)\) invokes the source oracle only through the law handle and exact support table returned for \(S\).
